8199.title: Pending machine recovery delays HTTP readiness
8199.rootCauseOneLine: Startup awaits machine recovery before opening HTTP; pending creation consumes the 60-second sweep-detach deadline and exceeds launcher health readiness.
8199.proposedFix: Run the existing error-handled machine recovery step in the background without changing the other awaited startup repairs or periodic sweep completion semantics.
8199.caveats: Two real-server reproductions and two focused timing checks; desktop checked statically, SSH and full launcher supervisor not executed. Reproducer and test are inline per reports repository policy.
